title: config/cron.yaml (parsed)
description: The schedule the Nornir scheduler (bin/nornir-cron-start.sh) actually runs (plan 58, Phase 7). cron.yaml is a LINE format — `HH:MM [@role[,role]] <command>`, either order — so the loader parses each live line into this document and validates THAT, because a line the scheduler cannot parse is a job that silently never fires. The role gate is the fleet's role law: heart · forge · dev · hand.

command.description: the command line the scheduler runs (bash -lc)

roles.description: the role gate (@heart,@forge); empty means any role
